caption: The drawing displays a single triangular folded handkerchief or cloth, rendered in shades of gray and off-white on a beige background. Most of the cloth is plain, while one edge is elaborately decorated with detailed floral and foliate motifs, featuring a symmetrical arrangement of leaves, flowers, and small round elements. Among the flora, two small birds are depicted, positioned with wings spread as if in flight. The outer border of the cloth is outlined with a repeated scalloped pattern, each scallop containing a small flower. The drawing is executed with fine, delicate lines, especially in the decorative portion, while the rest of the cloth is left largely unembellished. There is a faint stamp or watermark in the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Man's Handkerchief
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
